{
  "candidate_rtl": "module pw_block_prefix_add #(
    parameter WIDTH = 32
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] x, y,
    input wire cin,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] s
);
    localparam BLOCKS = (WIDTH + 3) / 4;
    localparam PAD = BLOCKS * 4;
    localparam LEVELS = $clog2(BLOCKS);
    wire [PAD-1:0] p, g;
    wire [BLOCKS-1:0] bp [0:LEVELS];
    wire [BLOCKS-1:0] bg [0:LEVELS];
    wire [BLOCKS:0] bc;
    wire [PAD-1:0] full_sum;
    assign bc[0] = cin;
    genvar i, k, l;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < PAD; i = i + 1) begin: bit_terms
            if (i < WIDTH) begin: real_bit
                assign p[i] = x[i] ^ y[i];
                assign g[i] = x[i] & y[i];
            end else begin: padding
                assign p[i] = 1'b1;
                assign g[i] = 1'b0;
            end
        end
        for (k = 0; k < BLOCKS; k = k + 1) begin: block_terms
            assign bp[0][k] = p[4*k+3] & p[4*k+2] & p[4*k+1] & p[4*k];
            assign bg[0][k] = g[4*k+3]
                | (p[4*k+3] & g[4*k+2])
                | (p[4*k+3] & p[4*k+2] & g[4*k+1])
                | (p[4*k+3] & p[4*k+2] & p[4*k+1] & g[4*k]);
        end
        for (l = 0; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin: prefix_level
            for (k = 0; k < BLOCKS; k = k + 1) begin: prefix_node
                if (k >= (1 << l)) begin: combine
                    assign bg[l+1][k] = bg[l][k] | (bp[l][k] & bg[l][k-(1 << l)]);
                    assign bp[l+1][k] = bp[l][k] & bp[l][k-(1 << l)];
                end else begin: forward
                    assign bg[l+1][k] = bg[l][k];
                    assign bp[l+1][k] = bp[l][k];
                end
            end
        end
        for (k = 0; k < BLOCKS; k = k + 1) begin: block_sum
            wire c1, c2, c3;
            assign bc[k+1] = bg[LEVELS][k] | (bp[LEVELS][k] & cin);
            assign c1 = g[4*k] | (p[4*k] & bc[k]);
            assign c2 = g[4*k+1] | (p[4*k+1] & g[4*k])
                | (p[4*k+1] & p[4*k] & bc[k]);
            assign c3 = g[4*k+2] | (p[4*k+2] & g[4*k+1])
                | (p[4*k+2] & p[4*k+1] & g[4*k])
                | (p[4*k+2] & p[4*k+1] & p[4*k] & bc[k]);
            assign full_sum[4*k] = p[4*k] ^ bc[k];
            assign full_sum[4*k+1] = p[4*k+1] ^ c1;
            assign full_sum[4*k+2] = p[4*k+2] ^ c2;
            assign full_sum[4*k+3] = p[4*k+3] ^ c3;
        end
    endgenerate
    assign s = full_sum[WIDTH-1:0];
endmodule

module pw_alu #(
    parameter WIDTH = 64
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire [2:0] Oper,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0] sum
);
    wire invert_a = (Oper == 3'b010);
    wire invert_b = (Oper == 3'b001);
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] arithmetic_x = a ^ {WIDTH{invert_a}};
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] arithmetic_y = b ^ {WIDTH{invert_b}};
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] arithmetic_sum;
    pw_block_prefix_add #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) arithmetic (
        .x(arithmetic_x), .y(arithmetic_y),
        .cin(invert_a | invert_b), .s(arithmetic_sum)
    );
    always @* begin
        case (Oper)
            3'b000, 3'b001, 3'b010: sum = arithmetic_sum;
            3'b011: sum = a | b;
            3'b100: sum = a & b;
            3'b101: sum = a ^ b;
            3'b110: sum = a ~^ b;
            default: sum = {WIDTH{1'b0}};
        endcase
    end
endmodule

module pw_pipeline_alu #(
    parameter WIDTH = 32,
    parameter STAGES = 2
)(
    input wire clk, rst,
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire [2:0] Oper,
    input wire in_valid,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] result,
    output wire out_valid
);
    reg [WIDTH-1:0] operand_a, operand_b;
    reg [2:0] opcode;
    reg input_valid;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] alu_result;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] stage_data [0:STAGES-2];
    wire stage_valid [0:STAGES-2];
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            operand_a <= 0;
            operand_b <= 0;
            opcode <= 0;
            input_valid <= 0;
        end else begin
            operand_a <= a;
            operand_b <= b;
            opcode <= Oper;
            input_valid <= in_valid;
        end
    end
    pw_alu #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) alu (
        .a(operand_a), .b(operand_b), .Oper(opcode), .sum(alu_result)
    );
    genvar index;
    generate
        for (index = 0; index < STAGES-1; index = index+1) begin: output_pipeline
            reg [WIDTH-1:0] data_reg;
            reg valid_reg;
            wire [WIDTH-1:0] next_data;
            wire next_valid;
            if (index == 0) begin: first_stage
                assign next_data = alu_result;
                assign next_valid = input_valid;
            end else begin: following_stage
                assign next_data = stage_data[index-1];
                assign next_valid = stage_valid[index-1];
            end
            always @(posedge clk) begin
                if (rst) begin
                    data_reg <= 0;
                    valid_reg <= 0;
                end else begin
                    data_reg <= next_data;
                    valid_reg <= next_valid;
                end
            end
            assign stage_data[index] = data_reg;
            assign stage_valid[index] = valid_reg;
        end
    endgenerate
    assign result = stage_data[STAGES-2];
    assign out_valid = stage_valid[STAGES-2];
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The operand/opcode-register to first output-register path contains arithmetic carry propagation and final operation selection. Three separately expressed arithmetic operations can also increase mapping area and routing load.",
  "rewrite": "Share one arithmetic datapath across addition and both subtraction directions. Form a+b, a+~b+1, or ~a+b+1 using opcode-controlled operand inversion. Replace inferred arithmetic with four-bit carry-lookahead blocks and a parallel prefix across blocks; WIDTH=32 uses eight blocks and three inter-block prefix levels. Keep the original pipeline and all named state registers unchanged.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The explicit hierarchical carry network is intended to shorten the arithmetic carry path and improve setup WNS. Sharing arithmetic also reduces the final arithmetic-result selection. Actual gain depends on SKY130HD mapping and routing; no measured STA result is claimed.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "One shared adder replaces three arithmetic operators, providing area headroom for prefix carry logic. Operand-inversion controls add fanout and delay, and the prefix network adds wiring. The 10341.668480um2 cap and electrical limits require confirmation with the specified implementation flow.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves modular WIDTH-bit arithmetic, all seven operations, zero default, unsigned ports, and parameterized widths. Pipeline latency, synchronous reset priority, valid propagation, and data updates independent of validity are unchanged. No registers are added or removed, no initialization is introduced, and repeated resets require no additional assumptions. Equivalence and mapped timing checks have not been run here."
}
